description: Event catalogue for the Faster Payment Initiation journey. Introduces 8 new events: EVT-179 through EVT-186. SanctionsScreeningCompleted (EVT-180) reuses the schema pattern established in JRN-001 but with payment-specific payload fields. All events are routed via SVC-102 (event bus). Financial and PII-tagged events are also written to the WORM audit pipeline (SVC-111).
catalogue_principles: All event names are in past tense (domain event naming convention)
Payload schemas carry the minimum data required for consumers to act — raw PII is not included in payloads beyond identifiers
Fraud scores are included in FraudScoreCompleted payload but access-controlled at the consumer level — only SVC-001 and SVC-013 consumers may read fraud_score; SVC-103 receives a redacted copy

events.name: PaymentIntentCreated
events.trigger: PER-001 has completed SCA and the channel has called POST /payments. SVC-001 has validated account status (active), available balance, and daily payment limit. PaymentIntent is created with status = pending_screening.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-001); consumed by CAP-005 (SVC-051), CAP-004 (SVC-013), and SVC-103. Initiates concurrent cross-capability pre-execution checks.

payload_schema.cop_result: string enum (match | partial_match | no_match | not_available | account_does_not_exist)
payload_schema.cop_override_confirmed: boolean — true if customer overrode a non-match CoP result
payload_schema.device_fingerprint_hash: string — SHA-256 hash of device fingerprint (for fraud scoring; not raw PII)
payload_schema.session_id: string — channel session identifier (for fraud scoring behavioural context)

consumers.action: Runs real-time OFSI/UN/EU/OFAC sanctions screen against payee_name, payee_sort_code, payee_account_number, and customer_id (payer-side chain check). Publishes SanctionsScreeningCompleted.
Runs ML fraud scoring using payment amount, payee details, cop_result, device_fingerprint_hash, session_id, and historical patterns. Publishes FraudScoreCompleted.
Creates immutable audit log entry for payment initiation. Writes to WORM pipeline.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key on topic retail.payments. All payment events for a given account_id are sequenced within the same partition.
events.worm_rationale: Contains customer_id (PII) and payment amount (financial). Required for APP fraud reimbursement audit trail (GOV-003-R01) and OFSI screening log (GOV-005-R02). Retained 5 years minimum.

events.name: SanctionsScreeningCompleted
events.source_entity_name: Stateless — no owning entity in SVC-051
events.trigger: SVC-051 completes a real-time sanctions screen triggered by PaymentIntentCreated. Screen runs against OFSI Consolidated List, UN Consolidated List, EU Consolidated List, and US OFAC SDN List. Result is either clear or hit.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-005 (SVC-051); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001). Result determines whether payment proceeds to execution.
events.jrn001_schema_note: This event type was first defined in JRN-001 for onboarding-time screening. JRN-002 reuses the same schema with the addition of payment-specific context fields (payment_intent_id, payee fields).

payload_schema.screening_result_id: string (UUID v4) — unique screening result identifier, references SVC-103 audit log entry
payload_schema.payment_intent_id: string (UUID v4) — correlation to originating PaymentIntent
payload_schema.match_confidence: decimal (0.0–1.0) — only meaningful when outcome = hit; omitted or null when outcome = clear
payload_schema.screening_duration_ms: integer — milliseconds taken to complete the screen

consumers.action: Evaluates outcome. If clear: records screening_result_id on PaymentIntent. If outcome is clear AND EVT-181 (FraudScoreCompleted) also received with non-block result, publishes PaymentCleared. If hit: updates PaymentIntent.status = sanctions_blocked and publishes PaymentFailed. Alerts MLRO (PER-052).
Immutably logs all screening results (including cleared hits) for OFSI compliance. Minimum retention: 5 years.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key on topic compliance.screening.
events.worm_rationale: OFSI requires audit log of all sanctions screening decisions including cleared hits. GOV-005-R02. Retained 5 years minimum.

events.name: FraudScoreCompleted
events.source_entity_name: Stateless — no owning entity in SVC-013 for this journey
events.trigger: SVC-013 completes ML fraud scoring triggered by consuming PaymentIntentCreated. Scoring incorporates payment amount, payee, CoP result, device fingerprint, behavioural biometrics, and account history.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-004 (SVC-013); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001). Result influences PaymentCleared vs PaymentFraudBlocked decision.

payload_schema.fraud_score_id: string (UUID v4) — unique scoring result identifier
payload_schema.payment_intent_id: string (UUID v4) — correlation to originating PaymentIntent
payload_schema.fraud_score: decimal (0.0–1.0) — 0 = minimal risk, 1 = maximum risk. Access-controlled: field is payload-level encrypted for SVC-001 consumption only; SVC-103 receives a redacted version without the raw score value.
payload_schema.risk_level: string enum (low | medium | high | block) — derived from fraud_score against configurable thresholds
payload_schema.model_version: string — ML model version used for scoring (for audit and model drift tracking)
payload_schema.top_risk_features: array<string> — top 3 contributing model features (human-readable labels, not raw values, e.g. 'unusual_amount_vs_history', 'cop_no_match', 'new_payee'). Used by Fraud Analyst (PER-054) in case review.
payload_schema.scoring_duration_ms: integer — milliseconds taken to complete scoring

consumers.action: Evaluates risk_level. If non-block AND EVT-180 (SanctionsScreeningCompleted) also received with clear outcome: publishes PaymentCleared. If risk_level = block: updates PaymentIntent.status = fraud_blocked, publishes PaymentFraudBlocked, alerts Fraud Analyst (PER-054). Stores fraud_score and risk_level on PaymentIntent (access-controlled fields).

Receives a version of the event with fraud_score redacted (risk_level retained). Creates audit log entry. Raw fraud_score is not in the SVC-103 general log — it is retained only in SVC-013's internal model audit store.

events.access_control_note: fraud_score raw value must not be surfaced to PER-001 under any circumstances. It is also not surfaced in the SVC-103 general audit log to limit exposure. PER-054 (Fraud Analyst) has direct access to SVC-013 decision explanation interface for case investigation.
events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key on topic fraud.scores.
events.worm_rationale: Fraud scoring decisions are part of the APP fraud reimbursement audit trail (GOV-003-R01). Required for gross negligence assessment. risk_level (not raw score) retained in WORM pipeline.

events.name: PaymentCleared
events.trigger: SVC-001 has received both SanctionsScreeningCompleted (outcome = clear) and FraudScoreCompleted (risk_level != block) for the same payment_intent_id. All pre-execution checks are clear. PaymentIntent.status transitions to processing.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-001); consumed by CAP-003 (SVC-009). Crosses the Retail Banking → Payment Operations boundary.

payload_schema.sanctions_screening_result_id: string — reference to SVC-103 screening audit log entry
payload_schema.fraud_risk_level: string enum (low | medium | high) — included for SVC-009 records; never block at this point

consumers.action: Constructs and submits ISO 20022 pacs.008 FPS payment instruction to Vocalink. Creates PaymentExecution entity. On scheme acceptance, publishes PaymentExecuted.
Records the payment cleared decision in the audit log.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key on topic retail.payments.
events.worm_rationale: Records the point at which the bank authorised the payment for execution. Required for APP fraud reimbursement audit trail.

events.name: PaymentExecuted
events.trigger: SVC-009 has submitted the FPS pacs.008 instruction to Vocalink and received a positive acceptance acknowledgement (pacs.002 ACCP). The PaymentExecution entity is created with settlement_status = accepted.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-003 (SVC-009); consumed by CAP-001 (SVC-001) for account debit. Crosses the Payment Operations → Retail Banking boundary.

payload_schema.fps_reference: string — FPS end-to-end identifier assigned by Vocalink (max 35 chars)
payload_schema.settlement_status: string enum (accepted) — only accepted triggers this event; rejection triggers PaymentFailed

consumers.action: Debits the account ledger by payment amount. Updates PaymentIntent.status = completed. Updates Account.daily_payment_total and Account.last_payment_date. Publishes AccountDebited.
Writes the confirmed execution to the OFSI audit log — records that a screened payment was executed. Required by GOV-005-R02 for completeness of the screening audit trail.
Immutably records the FPS execution with fps_reference in the WORM audit pipeline.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key on topic payments.execution.
events.worm_rationale: FPS execution record with fps_reference is the primary audit evidence for APP fraud reimbursement claims and OFSI payment tracing obligations.

events.name: AccountDebited
events.trigger: SVC-001 has consumed PaymentExecuted and atomically debited the account ledger. PaymentIntent.status = completed. Account.daily_payment_total updated.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-001); consumed by CAP-005 (SVC-014 — AML transaction monitoring) and SVC-017 (channel — triggers confirmation screen). Crosses Retail Banking → Compliance boundary.

payload_schema.new_daily_payment_total: string (decimal as string) — updated daily total for monitoring purposes

consumers.action: Ingests the debit transaction for ongoing AML transaction monitoring (GOV-005-R01). Updates account transaction monitoring profile. May trigger SAR referral if the payment matches a suspicious activity typology.
Signals that the payment is fully complete. Channel can now render the final confirmation screen. Also triggers SVC-053 to dispatch the payment confirmation push notification and email.
Records account debit in the WORM audit pipeline.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key on topic retail.accounts.
events.worm_rationale: Account debit is a financial event subject to FCA BCOBS records retention (7 years) and AML monitoring obligations.

events.name: PaymentFailed
events.trigger: Payment cannot proceed due to: (a) insufficient funds, (b) daily payment limit exceeded, (c) sanctions hit (outcome = hit in EVT-180), (d) FPS submission failure after retry exhaustion (published by SVC-009 and then re-emitted by SVC-001 with updated PaymentIntent), or (e) sanctions screening service timeout (fail-closed behaviour).
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by SVC-001 (CAP-001) or SVC-009 (CAP-003) depending on failure point. Consumed by SVC-017 (channel) for customer notification.

payload_schema.failure_reason: string enum (insufficient_funds | daily_limit_exceeded | fps_rejection | fps_timeout | sanctions_review | sanctions_timeout_hold)
payload_schema.fps_reject_reason_code: string — ISO 20022 pacs.002 reason code. Only present when failure_reason = fps_rejection
payload_schema.customer_facing_message_key: string — i18n message key for the channel to look up the appropriate customer-facing message. The failure_reason is NOT directly surfaced to the customer — the message key maps to an approved message.

consumers.action: Renders the appropriate failure message to PER-001 using the customer_facing_message_key. For sanctions_review: generic decline. For insufficient_funds: specific balance message. For fps_rejection: retry/contact support message.
Records the payment failure with full failure_reason in the WORM audit log (including the sanctions_review reason — which must not appear in the customer-facing message).

events.tipping_off_control: The failure_reason = sanctions_review must never be surfaced to PER-001. The customer_facing_message_key for sanctions_review maps to the generic decline message. SVC-017 must not render the raw failure_reason value.
events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key on topic retail.payments.
events.worm_rationale: Payment failures including sanctions-related blocks must be retained for OFSI audit compliance and APP fraud reimbursement claim processing.

events.name: PaymentFraudBlocked
events.trigger: SVC-001 consumed FraudScoreCompleted (EVT-181) with risk_level = block. PaymentIntent.status transitions to fraud_blocked. A fraud analyst case is created.
events.capability_scope_rationale: Published by CAP-001 (SVC-001); consumed by CAP-004 (SVC-013 — for case creation in fraud operations platform) and SVC-017 (channel — generic decline message). Internal alert to PER-054 (Fraud Analyst).

payload_schema.fraud_score_id: string (UUID v4) — reference to SVC-013 scoring result
payload_schema.top_risk_features: array<string> — top contributing model features (for Fraud Analyst case review)

consumers.action: Creates a fraud investigation case in the Fraud Operations Platform (INTL-003). Assigns to available Fraud Analyst (PER-054). Case includes full fraud model explanation and top_risk_features.
Renders the fraud block decline screen to PER-001: 'We've blocked this payment for your security. If you authorised this payment, please call [fraud line].' No fraud score or risk level is disclosed.
Records the fraud block event in the WORM audit pipeline. risk_level recorded; raw fraud_score not included in SVC-103 entry.

events.ordering_guarantees: Per-account strict ordering via account_id partition key on topic fraud.blocks.
events.worm_rationale: Fraud block decisions form part of the APP fraud reimbursement claims audit trail (GOV-003-R01) and are required evidence for the gross negligence defence assessment. Retained 5 years.
